en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a dense religious procession moving along a narrow street or ravine lined with multi‑story houses. In the foreground are Orthodox clergy in vestments carrying icons and crosses, followed by a large crowd. Above the scene, partly visible buildings and a slender minaret suggest an urban setting with both Christian and Muslim architecture. At the top there is a decorative cartouche with Greek text, and at the bottom appears a small website watermark and a printed number.
